definitions.explanation: The removal of visible body hair at the skin's surface using methods such as shaving, creams, or wax. Unlike laser treatments, this does not destroy the hair follicle.

examples.japanese: {除毛|じょもう}⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}った→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。

{除毛|じょもう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}びたい→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I want to choose a hair removal method that's gentle on the skin.

examples.japanese: {除毛|じょもう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一時的|いちじてき}→一時的：05846_ichijiteki⟧な⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧⟦しかない→〜しかない：30533_shikanai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{手軽|てがる}→手軽：07176_tegaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{自宅|じたく}→自宅：00129_jitaku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦できる→できる：00557_dekiru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{利点|りてん}→利点：11787_riten⟧だ。
examples.english: Hair removal only has a temporary effect, but the advantage is that it can be easily done at home.

notes:
A compound of {除|じょ} (remove, eliminate) and {毛|もう} (hair). This word specifically refers to surface-level hair removal methods that do not affect the hair root or follicle, meaning the hair grows back.

The key distinction between {除毛|じょもう} and ⟦{脱毛|だつもう}→脱毛：24914_datsumou⟧ is important in the beauty industry: {除毛|じょもう} removes hair at the surface (temporary), while ⟦{脱毛|だつもう}→脱毛：24914_datsumou⟧ targets the root (potentially permanent).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {除毛|じょもう}⟦クリーム→クリーム：00253_kuriimu⟧: depilatory cream
- {除毛|じょもう}⟦スプレー→スプレー：11581_supuree⟧: hair removal spray
- {除毛|じょもう}⟦ワックス→ワックス：28758_wakkusu⟧: hair removal wax
- {除毛|じょもう}⟦{効果|こうか}→効果：02726_kouka⟧: hair removal effectiveness

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{脱毛|だつもう}→脱毛：24914_datsumou⟧: hair removal (general) / hair loss — broader term; includes both cosmetic removal at the root level and involuntary hair loss
- {剃毛|ていもう}: shaving body hair — specifically using a razor
- ⟦{永久|えいきゅう}→永久：01875_eikyuu⟧⟦{脱毛|だつもう}→脱毛：24914_datsumou⟧: permanent hair removal — laser or electrolysis treatments that destroy the follicle
